--- title: "Time-Series of Admissions & Clinical Events" subtitle: "Module 02 — Health Analytics with R" --- ![](Images/banner_health_analytics.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"} ### Health Analytics with R · Module 02: EDA in Healthcare *** **Learning objectives** - Aggregate daily, weekly, and monthly admission counts with `lubridate` floor dates - Detect seasonality and long-term trends in hospital admissions - Overlay policy/intervention events as annotated vertical markers - Compute rolling averages and Bollinger-style control limits - Decompose a time-series into trend, seasonality, and residual - Build an interactive Plotly time-series chart **Estimated time:** 1.5 hours | **Level:** Intermediate | **Libraries:** `dplyr` / tibble, ggplot2, `stats`, plotly, lubridate ## 1. Setup & Time-Series Dataset ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(ggplot2) library(patchwork) library(lubridate) library(scales) library(plotly) mod02_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod02") dir.create(mod02_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE) theme_health <- function(base_size = 12) { theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) + theme( panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA) ) } theme_set(theme_health()) # ── Reconstruct dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── set.seed(42) N <- 800 ages <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95)) sexes <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52)) payers <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03)) drg_codes <- sample(c(470, 291, 392, 690, 871, 193, 247, 603), N, replace = TRUE) drg_labels_map <- c( `470` = "Major joint replacement", `291` = "Heart failure & shock", `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI", `690` = "Kidney/UTI", `871` = "Septicemia", `193` = "Simple pneumonia", `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis" ) los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30)) charges <- round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200), 2) charges[runif(N) < 0.08] <- NA_real_ primary_dx <- sample(c("E11.9", "I10", "N18.3", "I50.9", "J18.9", "A41.9", "M16.11", "N39.0"), N, replace = TRUE) admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent", "Newborn"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02)) set.seed(99) df <- tibble( patient_id = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)), age = ages, sex = sexes, payer = payers, drg_code = drg_codes, drg_label = unname(drg_labels_map[as.character(drg_codes)]), primary_dx = primary_dx, admit_type = admit_type, los_days = los_days, total_charge = charges, diabetes = rbinom(N, 1, 0.32), hypertension = rbinom(N, 1, 0.45), ckd = rbinom(N, 1, 0.15), heart_failure = rbinom(N, 1, 0.18), readmitted_30 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.14) ) df$age_group <- cut(df$age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95), labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+")) start <- as.Date("2019-01-01") set.seed(5) n_days <- as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start) df$admit_date <- as.Date(start + sample(0:(n_days - 1), N, replace = TRUE)) df$discharge_date <- df$admit_date + df$los_days df <- df %>% arrange(admit_date) # ── Add COVID-style shock to 2020 ───────────────────────────────────────────── # (already embedded in data via seed; we add a synthetic elective drop marker) cat(sprintf("Admissions: %d | Date range: %s → %s\n", nrow(df), min(df$admit_date), max(df$admit_date))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Admissions: 800 | Date range: 2019-01-02 → 2023-12-29 ``` ::: ::: ## 2. Resampling — Daily, Weekly, Monthly Counts ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} daily <- df %>% count(date = admit_date, name = "admissions") %>% complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "day"), fill = list(admissions = 0)) weekly <- df %>% count(date = floor_date(admit_date, "week"), name = "admissions") %>% complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "week"), fill = list(admissions = 0)) monthly <- df %>% count(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month"), name = "admissions") %>% complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "month"), fill = list(admissions = 0)) plot_resolution <- function(ts, title, colour) { ggplot(ts, aes(x = date, y = admissions)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = admissions), fill = colour, alpha = 0.20) + geom_line(colour = colour, linewidth = if (title == "Daily admissions") 0.4 else 0.8) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") + labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "N admissions") + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) } p_res <- plot_resolution(daily, "Daily admissions", "#AEC6CF") / plot_resolution(weekly, "Weekly admissions", "#2563EB") / plot_resolution(monthly, "Monthly admissions", "#1F4E79") + plot_annotation(title = "Admission counts at three temporal resolutions") print(p_res) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "ts_resolutions.png"), p_res, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300) cat(sprintf("Monthly — mean: %.1f std: %.1f\n", mean(monthly$admissions), sd(monthly$admissions))) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Monthly — mean: 13.3 std: 3.5 ``` ::: ::: ## 3. Rolling Averages & Control Limits ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} roll_k <- 7 daily <- daily %>% mutate( roll_mean = as.numeric(stats::filter(admissions, rep(1 / roll_k, roll_k), sides = 2)), roll_std = as.numeric(sqrt(stats::filter(admissions^2, rep(1 / roll_k, roll_k), sides = 2) - roll_mean^2)), upper_cl = roll_mean + 2 * roll_std, lower_cl = pmax(roll_mean - 2 * roll_std, 0) ) events <- tibble( dt = as.Date(c("2020-03-15", "2020-06-01", "2021-01-01", "2022-09-01")), label = c("COVID-19 onset", "Elective resumption", "Vaccine rollout", "Policy change"), colour = c("#DC2626", "#16A34A", "purple", "orange") ) p_roll <- ggplot(daily, aes(x = date)) + geom_line(aes(y = admissions, colour = "Daily"), linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.8) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_cl, ymax = upper_cl, fill = "±2 SD control band"), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) + geom_line(aes(y = roll_mean, colour = "7-day rolling mean"), linewidth = 1.0) + geom_vline(data = events, aes(xintercept = dt, colour = label), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) + geom_text(data = events, aes(x = dt, y = max(daily$admissions, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.92, label = label, colour = label), size = 2.8, vjust = 1, show.legend = FALSE) + scale_colour_manual( values = c("Daily" = "#B0C4DE", "7-day rolling mean" = "#1F4E79", setNames(events$colour, events$label)), breaks = c("Daily", "7-day rolling mean") ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("±2 SD control band" = "#1F4E79")) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") + labs(y = "Admissions per day", x = NULL, colour = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Daily admissions with 7-day rolling mean and ±2 SD control band") + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom") print(p_roll) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 6 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_ribbon()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 6 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_line()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "ts_rolling_control.png"), p_roll, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 6 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_ribbon()`). Removed 6 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_line()`). ``` ::: ::: ## 4. Seasonal Heatmap — Month × Year ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} monthly_pivot <- df %>% mutate(year = year(admit_date), month = month(admit_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) %>% count(year, month) %>% complete(year, month, fill = list(n = 0)) p_heat <- ggplot(monthly_pivot, aes(x = month, y = factor(year), fill = n)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3) + scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, name = "Admissions") + labs(title = "Admission count heatmap — year × month", x = "Month", y = "Year") + theme_health() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) print(p_heat) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "heatmap_season.png"), p_heat, width = 13, height = 4, dpi = 300) ``` ::: ## 5. Seasonal Decomposition ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Use monthly series (requires ≥2 full periods) ts_monthly <- ts(monthly$admissions, frequency = 12, start = c(year(min(monthly$date)), month(min(monthly$date)))) decomp <- decompose(ts_monthly, type = "additive") decomp_df <- tibble( date = monthly$date, Observed = as.numeric(decomp$x), Trend = as.numeric(decomp$trend), Seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$seasonal), Residual = as.numeric(decomp$random) ) %>% pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") %>% mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("Observed", "Trend", "Seasonal", "Residual"))) comp_cols <- c(Observed = "#1F4E79", Trend = "#DC2626", Seasonal = "#16A34A", Residual = "#B47CC7") p_decomp <- ggplot(decomp_df, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = component)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) + geom_hline(data = tibble(component = factor(c("Seasonal", "Residual"), levels = levels(decomp_df$component)), yint = 0), aes(yintercept = yint), colour = "gray", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) + scale_colour_manual(values = comp_cols, guide = "none") + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") + facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") + labs(title = "Seasonal decomposition of monthly admissions (additive model)", x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) print(p_decomp) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "ts_decomposition.png"), p_decomp, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300) # Seasonal strength index seasonal_strength <- 1 - var(decomp$random, na.rm = TRUE) / var(decomp$seasonal + decomp$random, na.rm = TRUE) cat(sprintf("Seasonal strength index: %.3f (>0.64 = strong)\n", seasonal_strength)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Seasonal strength index: 0.235 (>0.64 = strong) ``` ::: ::: ## 6. Admission Trends by Diagnosis Group ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top_drgs <- df %>% count(drg_label, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 4) %>% pull(drg_label) monthly_drg <- df %>% filter(drg_label %in% top_drgs) %>% count(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month"), drg_label) %>% complete(date, drg_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>% group_by(drg_label) %>% mutate(roll = as.numeric(stats::filter(n, rep(1 / 3, 3), sides = 2))) %>% ungroup() colors_drg <- c("#1F4E79", "#DC2626", "#16A34A", "#B47CC7") names(colors_drg) <- unique(monthly_drg$drg_label) p_drg <- ggplot(monthly_drg, aes(x = date, y = roll, colour = drg_label, fill = drg_label)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = roll), alpha = 0.08, colour = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.0, na.rm = TRUE) + scale_colour_manual(values = colors_drg) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_drg) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") + labs(y = "Monthly admissions (3-month rolling mean)", x = NULL, colour = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Admission trends by DRG — top 4 diagnoses") + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom") print(p_drg) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 8 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_ribbon()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "ts_by_drg.png"), p_drg, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 8 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_ribbon()`). ``` ::: ::: ## 7. Interactive Chart with Plotly ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_p <- plot_ly() %>% add_lines(data = daily, x = ~date, y = ~admissions, name = "Daily", opacity = 0.4, line = list(color = "#AEC6CF", width = 1)) %>% add_lines(data = daily, x = ~date, y = ~roll_mean, name = "7-day mean", line = list(color = "#1F4E79", width = 2)) %>% add_ribbons(data = daily, x = ~date, ymin = ~lower_cl, ymax = ~upper_cl, name = "±2 SD band", fillcolor = "rgba(31,78,121,0.1)", line = list(color = "transparent"), hoverinfo = "skip") for (i in seq_len(nrow(events))) { fig_p <- fig_p %>% add_segments( x = events$dt[i], xend = events$dt[i], y = 0, yend = max(daily$admissions, na.rm = TRUE), line = list(dash = "dash", color = events$colour[i], width = 1), name = events$label[i], inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE ) %>% add_annotations( x = events$dt[i], y = 1, yref = "paper", text = events$label[i], showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 10, color = events$colour[i]) ) } fig_p <- fig_p %>% layout( title = "Interactive daily admissions (zoom / hover to explore)", xaxis = list(title = "Date"), yaxis = list(title = "Admissions"), height = 420, legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08), plot_bgcolor = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white" ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Specifying width/height in layout() is now deprecated. Please specify in ggplotly() or plot_ly() ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} fig_p ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 8. Knowledge Check 1. Why is an explicit month-end (`ceiling_date(..., "month")`) preferable to an ambiguous month label when aggregating admissions? 2. The seasonal strength index is 0.38. Is that strong seasonality? What would you do next? 3. An observation falls above the +2 SD control band in November 2021. List three possible causes. 4. Which decomposition model (additive vs multiplicative) should you use if the seasonal fluctuations grow proportionally with the trend? 5. Compute and plot the year-over-year percentage change in monthly admissions. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Exercise 5 — YoY % change yoy <- monthly %>% arrange(date) %>% mutate(yoy_pct = (admissions / lag(admissions, 12) - 1) * 100) %>% filter(!is.na(yoy_pct)) %>% mutate(col = if_else(yoy_pct < 0, "#DC2626", "#2563EB")) p_yoy <- ggplot(yoy, aes(x = date, y = yoy_pct, fill = col)) + geom_col(width = 20, show.legend = FALSE) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) + scale_fill_identity() + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") + labs(y = "YoY change (%)", x = NULL, title = "Year-over-year % change in monthly admissions") + theme_health() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) print(p_yoy) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](MOD02_NB04_TimeSeries_Admissions_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: *** **Next → NB-05: Missingness Analysis & Imputation**
